name: A Very Merry Woodway Christmas at Carleen Bright Arboretum
paras: Woodway lights its Christmas tree on Thursday, December 17, 2026, at the Carleen Bright Arboretum. The evening runs from 5:30 to 8:30 pm and is billed as a night for the whole family.
The city lists a vendor market, local food trucks, crafts and pictures with Santa along with the tree lighting.
tip: The city's events page also lists the arboretum's holiday story time on December 9.

name: Holiday Story Time at Carleen Bright Arboretum
host: City of Woodway and Hewitt Public Library
paras: Hewitt Public Library staff read holiday classics at the Whitehall Center inside the Carleen Bright Arboretum on Wednesday, December 9, 2026, from 10 am to noon. A festive craft follows the reading.
The city suggests bringing a blanket and bundling up.
tip: Bring a blanket for sitting during the reading.

name: Sebastian Christmas Parade
paras: The City of Sebastian holds its Christmas parade on Saturday, December 5, 2026, at 6:30 pm. It starts at the Main Street Boat Ramp and travels south along Indian River Drive.
The parade ends at Riverview Park, where families can visit Santa and keep celebrating after the floats pass.
tip: Plan to walk to Riverview Park after the parade for Santa.

name: Titusville Christmas Parade
paras: The Titusville Christmas Parade has run since 1962 and returns on Saturday, December 12, 2026, at 6 pm. This year's theme is Christmas Among the Stars.
Indian River Church hosts the parade, and the tourism site lists the evening as running until 9 pm.

name: Christmas on Main Street Tree Lighting in Alachua
address: 15000 Bob Hitchcock's Main St, Alachua, FL 32615
paras: The City of Alachua hosts Christmas on Main Street on Friday, December 4, 2026, from 5 to 8 pm. It is a free community gathering built around the annual tree lighting.
Families can reserve a photo with Santa Claus, which the city calls a holiday tradition.
tip: Photos with Santa are by reservation, so check the city's page before you go.
